author: Ricardo Nogueira Garcia
releaseNotes: v1.1.0: renamed from PPA Connect Smart (Tuya Garage Door) Local; the driver is generic for Tuya ckmkzq garage door openers. Also tested with the Automatizador TSI (Garen) on protocol 3.3 (DP 1 and DP 3 only). Existing devices need to be switched to the new driver type. v1.0.0: first release (PPA Connect Smart skylight module, protocol 3.4).

x-catalog.description: Local driver (no Tuya Cloud) for Tuya Wi-Fi garage door, gate and skylight openers (category ckmkzq): door state, pulse command and an invert-state option. Tested with the PPA Connect Smart module and the Automatizador TSI (Garen).
